observations.body: Love stands within speech, knowledge, gifts, and maturity. If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal. But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 13:1–13 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states love stands within speech, knowledge, gifts, and maturity. If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal. But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
